about.title: About
about.metaDescription: Learn about Tony Hoang — teaching AI for beginners.
about.heroIntro: I dedicate my efforts to helping people who know nothing about AI get started and apply AI to their work and life with confidence.
about.storyP1: I started my journey with AI in 2020, when ChatGPT first launched. Like many others, I was confused and didn't know where to begin.
about.storyP2: After years of learning, experimenting, and having successes (and failures), I realized that AI isn't something distant. It can help everyone save hours every day, if you know how to use it right.
about.storyP3: From there, I decided to turn what I learned into courses, sharing freely to help more people access AI. No complexity. No pressure. Just simple and practical.
about.value1Desc: Everything complex can be explained simply. I believe anyone can learn.
about.value2Desc: Technology changes fast, so I always keep learning to bring the latest knowledge.
about.value3Desc: No empty theory. Every piece of knowledge is tied to immediate real-world application.
about.value4Desc: Everyone has their own learning pace. I don't rush — you just need to be ready to start.
about.infoCollaboration: Open for collaboration and teaching opportunities
about.ctaSubtitle: Ready to start your journey with AI? I'll be with you every step of the way.
